A single isolated ink line in the main column at about y 810–955, x 1160–2650. It has no shelfmark, date or extent. The initial letters of 'Yasavanta' and of the parenthetical 'Jasvant' are written with very similar looped forms. The diacritics of 'Simha' and 'Singh' cannot be securely read, and the candidate correctly leaves them uncertain. No connecting line leads from this line to the gutter. It is correctly treated as an independent author/title cross-reference, not as a heading for b003.

The shelfmark 'd. 1070(3)' is in the left column at about [440,2920,320,90]. Its first digit is a small stroke that resembles 'ı'. The entry text runs across the main column, and 'n.d. :2:18:D.' is at the right, ending at about x 3030. The stacked 's/o', the underdots in 'rakṣaṇa', and 'Janārdana' are visible. The subject word after 'Bāla.' could be 'Stotra' or the abbreviation 'Stotr.'; it remains uncertain.

A fine ink line rises slightly from after 'D.' at about x 3025 to x 3155, y about 2880–2900, toward the gutter. The arrowhead is at native x about 3210–3320, y about 2875, on the facing page. In the adjacent fol. 336 image, that arrow lies between d.1021(3) and d.999(9), with '...:2:18:D.' from this page visible to its left. The attachment to r003 is correct. This block duplicates the inventory's first unattached mark; it is the same feature, not a second one.

Faint mirrored show-through of handwriting covers the ruled area. The page annotations correctly record it as not text written on this page. Scattered specks, for example at about [1025,3600] and [1310,3750], are paper flecks, not marks.
